question: Should successful automatic model fallback remain durable session recovery state by default, or should OpenClaw add an opt-in per-turn fallback policy that retries the selected primary on the next turn?
rationale: Both policies are plausible, but choosing the default changes existing session-routing, provider retry, and operator expectations; source-level repair cannot safely choose that compatibility contract.

options.title: Add an opt-in per-turn policy
options.body: Keep durable automatic fallback as the default and add a documented scoped setting for agents that want the primary retried on every new turn.

options.title: Adopt universal rollback
options.body: Accept the behavioral break and update the compatibility, upgrade, and repeated-primary-failure contract before landing a rebased implementation.

options.title: Keep durable fallback only
options.body: Close or narrow the implementation and retain the current recovery model without adding a per-turn mode.

recommendation.title: Add an opt-in per-turn policy
recommendation.body: Keep durable automatic fallback as the default and add a documented scoped setting for agents that want the primary retried on every new turn.
